description: Pull economic and financial time series from about 90 statistics offices, central banks and international organisations (the IMF, OECD, Eurostat, ECB, BIS, World Bank, the Fed and national statistics offices) through one source: GDP, inflation, unemployment, interest rates, exchange rates and more. Find datasets and series, read values between two dates or just the latest one, and start a workflow when new data is published. No account or API key required.
